name: OffSecIntel Research Desk
description: A markdown-driven publication platform for cyber security research and threat intelligence. Posts and researcher profiles are authored as markdown with YAML frontmatter, resolved through a hierarchical taxonomy registry, and compiled to a fully static site. Features deep-linkable URIs, light/dark theming, interactive threat intel widgets (MITRE ATT&CK, CVE, IoC), per-post asset management, and an AI-assisted authoring copilot in local development.
